name: Pudu Robotics Puts One AI Model in Three Robots. The FCC Has Banned Its Humanoid and Quadruped From US Markets.
summary: Pudu Robotics CEO Felix Zhang details the company’s ‘One Brain, Multiple Embodiments’ strategy, running PuduFM 1.0 across three robot types. The FCC’s July 2026 ban, however, blocks the D9 humanoid ...
